title: Tenant isolation: snapshot thresholds and safe passback protocol
creator: Priya Desai
description: Implement a per-tenant circuit safeguard that uses lightweight 'snapshot thresholds' (short rolling windows with quantile-based heuristics) and a deterministic 'passback' fallback protocol to safely reroute or degrade requests when a tenant approaches or crosses SLO-aligned limits.
background: We currently have coarse per-path guardrails and model-level fallbacks in the runtime. Incidents this year show noisy neighbors and tenant bursts causing cascading retries across regions. Existing systems either trip too late or fully cut traffic, which harms high-priority tenants. We need a middle-ground: fast detection for tenant-specific thresholds, bounded degradation, and an auditable passback policy that returns safe, deterministic alternatives (cached responses, lightweight model variants, or soft-deny with structured error).
proposed_solution: 1) Snapshot thresholds: compute short-window metrics (30s, 5m) per tenant for latency P95/P99, error rate, and token throughput; compare to per-tenant SLOs with quantile hysteresis to avoid flapping. 2) Tiered actions: soft-shed (reduce batch size / enforce rate limiter), passback (route to cached/quantized variant or region cold-standby), graceful-deny (structured 503 with retry-after and telemetry). 3) Passback protocol: deterministic routing rules with fallthrough order, simulated dry-run mode, and per-tenant backstop quotas. 4) Observable controls: per-tenant dashboard, audit log of passback events, and an API to pin passback policy. 5) Default safety: for high-SLA tenants, prefer bounded retries and cold-standby region; for best-effort tenants prefer cached responses or structured denies.
acceptance_criteria: Snapshot threshold metrics emitted for 100% of tenants (30s, 5m windows) to metrics pipeline
Passback policy engine supports 3 ordered actions: cached-response, quantized-variant, cross-region cold-standby
No silent drops: every passback action must generate an audit event and observable trace
Simulated dry-run shows <1% false positives where passback would have triggered for last 7 days of traffic
End-to-end E2E tests for soft-shed and passback with injected faults (latency spikes, model OOMs) pass in CI
Feature flagged rollout to 10 pilot tenants and 3 regions with rollback within 30 minutes
implementation_notes: Metric aggregation: use existing statsd -> metrics-kafka path; add tenant dimension and 30s/5m rollup keys
Decision engine lives in the runtime guardian: implement lightweight snapshotter that keeps ring buffers per-tenant and computes P95/P99 without heavy cardinality explosions
Passback actions implemented as deterministic policy chain; each action must include action_id and reason code
Grace windows: require action to persist for two consecutive windows before escalating from soft-shed to passback
Config: per-tenant policy stored in config-store with TTL and versioning; default policy served by control plane
Dry-run: runtime will log what action would be taken and send to a separate telemetry topic for validation
monitoring_and_alerting: Alert: Tenant passback rate > 0.5% of requests for more than 10m -> Pager (oncall-reliability)
SLO regression dashboard: show tenant-level P95/P99 and compare to pre-passback baseline
Audit log sink: passback events appended to customer audit log with action, reason, and selected fallback
Synthetic checks: weekly multi-region synthetic traffic to ensure cold-standby passback latency < 500ms added overhead
Runbook: documented steps for investigating a passback storm (links in Confluence)
rollout_plan: Feature flag gated: off by default
Phase 1 (dry-run): enable for 10 non-critical tenants in us-west-2, collect telemetry for 2 weeks
Phase 2 (pilot): enable soft-shed + passback for 3 enterprise pilot tenants with opt-in and runbook
Phase 3 (regional): expand to additional regions, enable cross-region cold-standby for high-SLA tenants
Phase 4 (global): enable for all tenants with conservative defaults and 14-day monitoring before relaxing thresholds
testing_plan: Unit tests for snapshotter and quantile calculation with synthetic distributions
Integration tests that inject latency and verify ordered passback actions
Chaos test: OOM/slow-model in primary region triggers passback to cold-standby in staging
Load test: simulate 1000 tenants with bursty behavior to validate ring-buffer memory usage
Customer-facing contract tests to ensure structured 503 payloads remain stable
dependencies: ENG-90200: metrics-kafka schema upgrade to include tenant_id dimension
ENG-90711: control-plane config-store versioning and per-tenant policy API
PM-401: pilot tenant selection & billing adjustments
SEC-128: audit-log retention policy and KMS key for audit sink
